bc02.unmeasurable: The criterion contains "{word}" but neither a number nor a unit, so it cannot be tested.
bc03.estimate_too_large: The estimate {estimate} is above the threshold {max_estimate}.
bc03.too_many_criteria: {count} acceptance criteria are more than the allowed {max_criteria}.
bc04.multiple_concerns: "{word}" may join several concerns; can the item be split?
bc05.missing_benefit: The story states no benefit ("so that …", "in order to …").
bc06.missing_estimate: The item is ranked {rank}, within the top {top}, but has no estimate.
bc07.hidden_dependency: The text mentions {id}, which is not listed as a dependency.
bc08.rank_order: The item is ranked {rank}, ahead of {dependency} (rank {dependency_rank}), which it depends on.
bc08.priority_order: The item has priority {priority}, but {dependency}, which it depends on, only {dependency_priority}.
bc08.rank_and_priority_order: The item is ranked {rank}, ahead of {dependency} (rank {dependency_rank}), which it depends on, and has a higher priority ({priority} instead of {dependency_priority}).
bc12.story_without_epic: The story belongs to no epic.
bc13.stale: The item has not changed for {days} days (last on {updated}); {max_days} days are allowed.
bc14.missing_repro_steps: The bug describes no steps to reproduce it.
bc15.missing_goal: The epic states no goal: the description has {words} words, at least {min_words} are required.
bc16.unfilled_placeholder: The text still contains the placeholder "{text}".
bc01.fix_missing: Add testable acceptance criteria, one sentence each, e.g. "Given <context>, when <action>, then <expected result>." and an edge case "Given <edge case>, when <action>, then <behaviour on failure>."
bc01.fix_missing_bug: Add the expected behaviour as a criterion, e.g. "After <steps> the application shows <expected result> instead of <error>."
bc02.fix_replace_word: Replace "{word}" with a measurable value, e.g. "{hint}".
bc02.fix_unmeasurable: Replace "{word}" with a number and unit or an observable result.
bc03.fix_split_estimate: Split the item into at least {parts} items of at most {max_estimate} points each, e.g. by workflow step, data type, user group or edge case.
bc03.fix_split_criteria: Split the item into at least {parts} items with at most {max_criteria} criteria each; keep related criteria together.
bc04.fix_split: Check whether "{word}" joins two concerns, and if so create one item per concern.
bc05.fix_add_benefit: Add the benefit of "{title}" as a sentence, e.g. "As a <role> I want <activity> so that <benefit>."
bc06.fix_estimate: Estimate the item before the next planning; if the estimate is above {max_estimate}, split it.
bc07.fix_add_dependency: Add {id} to the dependencies, or remove the mention if there is no dependency.
bc08.fix_rank_order: Move {dependency} ahead of rank {rank} or move the item behind rank {dependency_rank}.
bc08.fix_priority_order: Raise the priority of {dependency} to {priority} or lower the priority of this item to {dependency_priority}.
bc08.fix_rank_and_priority_order: Move {dependency} ahead of rank {rank} and raise its priority to {priority}, or move the item behind rank {dependency_rank} with priority {dependency_priority}.
bc09.fix_break_cycle: Break the cycle {items}: remove one dependency or extract the shared part into an item that both depend on.
bc10.fix_merge: Merge the item with {other}, or set the two apart in title and description.
bc11.fix_align: Agree on the value of "{term}" with {other} and use the same value in both items.
bc12.fix_add_stories: Create the epic's stories and set the epic as their parent, or close the epic.
bc12.fix_assign_epic: Assign the story to an epic (field "parent").
bc12.fix_assign_epic_candidate: Assign the story to an epic; {epic} looks like a match (field "parent").
bc13.fix_review: Check whether the item still applies (last changed on {updated}); update or close it.
bc14.fix_add_steps: Add "Steps to reproduce: 1. <…> 2. <…> Expected: <…> Actual: <…>" to the description.
bc15.fix_add_goal: Describe the goal in at least {min_words} words, e.g. "Goal: <outcome for whom>. Achieved when <measurable criterion>."
bc16.fix_fill_placeholder: Replace "{text}" with the actual content or remove the placeholder.
